research_question: Owned-page scope: Evaluating the Total Cost of Clio Legal Software. Planned sources and method: Clio official pricing and help documentation; cost a defined firm scenario. Build a source-labelled comparison covering Clio pricing and legal software integrations; record dates, definitions and sample limits. Sources are proposed, not verified findings.

research_brief.purpose: Give law firm buyers a dated, source-labelled method to estimate the full annual cost of Clio legal software beyond the listed Starter price.
research_brief.audience: Managing partners, COOs, and operations or billing leads at small and mid-sized U.S. law firms evaluating Clio for 2026-2027.
research_brief.data_period: Vendor pricing, fee, and help-center pages as displayed on October 2, 2026 and rechecked the same day before publication sign-off
research_brief.scope_limitations: Desk research from public Clio pages only; no quote was requested and no hands-on product test was performed. Core, Signature, and Elite prices are quote-only and are not estimated. Calculations are illustrative arithmetic on published rates.

statistics.claim: Clio Starter is listed from $49 per user per month in the U.S.
statistics.limitations: Starting price; annual-billing discounts and taxes not stated.

statistics.claim: Ten Starter seats cost $5,880 per year ($49 x 10 x 12).
statistics.method: Verdict Point arithmetic on the listed rate
statistics.limitations: Illustrative; excludes add-ons, fees, taxes, and discounts.

statistics.claim: Clio Payments charges 2.95% for standard cards and 3.75% for American Express.
statistics.limitations: Older Clio page shows 3.5% for American Express; confirm before signing.

statistics.claim: Pay Later with Affirm carries a 4.95% per-transaction fee paid by the firm, for payments of $50 to $30,000.
statistics.limitations: Applies to U.S. dollar range stated; CAD range differs.

statistics.claim: At $25,000 per month in card payments, card fees total about $8,850 per year at 2.95%.
statistics.limitations: Illustrative; assumes all payments are standard cards.

content_gaps: No ranking page models Clio payment fees against the subscription.
No ranking page treats connected-app subscriptions as part of the Clio budget.
Several pages show retired plan names and old prices.
Migration scope and internal staff time are missing from every competitor reviewed.
value_add: A dated, layer-by-layer cost model built only from Clio's current public pages, with seat-count and payment-fee calculations, a connected-app worksheet, and a signing checklist, plus a note where Clio's own pages disagree.
